answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1938 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lantern. The violet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the knoll queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Bonded capital sits idle for 14 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
